Maya (People Ops): Quick heads-up — rolling out two small but important changes that go into effect May 1.
Maya (People Ops): 1) Dependent Care Stipend: $500/year for primary caregivers to reimburse childcare, eldercare, or special-needs expenses. Eligible after 90 days of employment, pro-rated for new hires. Submit receipts via Expensify -> account: Redwood-DependentCare.
Maya (People Ops): 2) PTO tiering update: we’re simplifying accrual bands. All regular full-time ICs move to a flat 22 days/year base; senior ICs and managers get an add-on +3 days. This replaces the previous tenure-based bands. Accruals and carryover rules otherwise unchanged.
Devon (People Ops): Important: international variants apply — local statutory minimums still win. We’ve added a per-country table in the handbook (link below).
Maya (People Ops): FAQ + country table + sample receipt screenshots here: https://redwood.company/hr/handbook#dependent-care-stipend
Lina (Eng Manager): Quick Q — are contractors eligible? If not, any plan to include them later?
Devon (People Ops): Contractors (1099/contingent) are excluded for now. We’ll revisit in Q4; tracking feedback
Tom (Platform): For the stipend, can I submit recurring weekly invoices for daycare? Or only itemized receipts?
Maya (People Ops): Itemized receipts preferred. If you have a subscription invoice, include a brief note in Expensify and we can approve on a case-by-case basis.
Raj (CTO): Thanks team — appreciating the simplification on PTO bands, makes planning easier across teams.
Lina (Eng Manager): How does the PTO change affect hiring offers? Will new offers reflect the new bands immediately?
Devon (People Ops): Yes — all offers issued on/after May 1 will use the new PTO structure. Existing employees keep their current balances; future accruals follow the new bands.
Tom (Platform): Any limits on how many stipend reimbursements I can submit per year? E.g., $125 quarter or all at once?
Maya (People Ops): No hard sub-limits — $500 cap per calendar year. Recommend quarterly submissions for easier budgeting but submit however works for you.
hr-bot: Policy doc updated — Dependent Care Stipend & PTO Tiering (effective 2026-05-01). https://redwood.company/hr/handbook#dependent-care-stipend
Lina (Eng Manager): Thanks, filing in team update for next sync :white_check_mark:
Devon (People Ops): If you have edge cases (FMLA overlap, recent leaves, transfers across countries) ping us directly or book 15m with People Ops: https://calendly.com/redwood-people-ops/15
Maya (People Ops): Will follow up with a short newsletter and update on the payroll timelines (stipend reimbursements processed monthly). :sparkles:
Raj (CTO): Appreciated — small changes that really help families. :raised_hands:)
